_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ring_devices" ("device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "model" TEXT NULL, "firmware" TEXT NULL, "paired_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_sync_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NULL, "battery_percent" INTEGER NULL, "battery_charging" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("battery_charging" IN (0, 1)), "battery_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NULL, "unpaired_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NULL, "auto_heart_rate" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("auto_heart_rate" IN (0, 1)), "auto_spo2" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("auto_spo2" IN (0, 1)), "auto_stress" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("auto_stress" IN (0, 1)), "auto_hrv" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("auto_hrv" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("device_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_cursors" ("device_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ring_devices (device_id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "cursor_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("device_id", "kind"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_locks" ("name" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner" TEXT NOT NULL, "acquired_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expires_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("name"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_runs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ring_devices (device_id), "at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "outcome" TEXT NOT NULL, "kinds" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "record_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "battery_percent" INTEGER NULL, "battery_charging" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("battery_charging" IN (0, 1)), "failures" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "heart_rate_interval_seen_minutes" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "activity_buckets" ("device_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ring_devices (device_id), "start_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "duration_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "steps" INTEGER NOT NULL, "distance_meters" INTEGER NOT NULL, "active_kilocalories" REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("device_id", "start_utc_ms"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "hr_samples" ("device_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ring_devices (device_id), "at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "bpm" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("device_id", "at_utc_ms"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "spo2_samples" ("device_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ring_devices (device_id), "at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "percent" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("device_id", "at_utc_ms"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stress_samples" ("device_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ring_devices (device_id), "at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "level" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("device_id", "at_utc_ms"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "hrv_samples" ("device_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ring_devices (device_id), "at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "milliseconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("device_id", "at_utc_ms"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sleep_sessions" ("device_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ring_devices (device_id), "start_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("device_id", "start_utc_ms"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sleep_segments" ("device_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ring_devices (device_id), "start_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "stage" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_start_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("device_id", "start_utc_ms"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workouts" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "client_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "activity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NULL, "start_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_utc_ms" INTEGER NULL, "offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "distance_meters" REAL NULL, "active_kilocalories" REAL NULL, "elapsed_ms" INTEGER NULL, "average_heart_rate" INTEGER NULL, "max_heart_rate" INTEGER NULL, "effort_rating" INTEGER NULL, "checkpoint_utc_ms" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_hr_samples" ("workout_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES workouts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "bpm" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("workout_id", "at_utc_ms"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_route_points" ("workout_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES workouts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "latitude" REAL NOT NULL, "longitude" REAL NOT NULL, "altitude_meters" REAL NULL, "accuracy_meters" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("workout_id", "at_utc_ms"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_pauses" ("workout_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES workouts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "start_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("workout_id", "start_utc_ms"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "health_outbox" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NULL, "from_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "to_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "record_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "enqueued_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "completed_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "last_attempt_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NULL, "next_attempt_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "source_priorities" ("metric" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("metric", "source"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_profile" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(id = 1), "birth_year" INTEGER NULL, "sex" TEXT NULL, "height_centimeters" REAL NULL, "weight_kilograms" REAL NULL, "max_heart_rate" INTEGER NULL, "daily_step_goal" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "imported_sleep_sessions" ("record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "imported_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("record_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "imported_sleep_stages" ("record_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES imported_sleep_sessions (record_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "start_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "stage" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("record_id", "start_utc_ms"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "health_reads" ("kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "last_read_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("kind"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "imported_workouts" ("record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "activity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "imported_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "effort_rating" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("record_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "weigh_ins" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kilograms" REAL NOT NULL, "body_fat_percent" REAL NULL, "waist_centimeters" REAL NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "day_tags" ("date" TEXT NOT NULL, "tag" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("date"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "step_goal_changes" ("effective_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "steps" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("effective_date"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goals" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "pace" TEXT NULL, "started_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "anchor_kg" REAL NULL, "reference_kg" REAL NULL, "block_started_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "block_anchor_kg" REAL NULL, "phase" TEXT NOT NULL, "phase_since" TEXT NOT NULL, "phase_until" TEXT NULL, "levers" TEXT NOT NULL, "ended_on" TEXT NULL, "end_reason" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goal_weeks" ("goal_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES goals (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "monday" TEXT NOT NULL, "inputs" TEXT NOT NULL, "rule" TEXT NOT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "change" TEXT NULL, "answer" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("goal_id", "monday"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goal_screenings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "asked_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "soft_mode" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("soft_mode" IN (0, 1)), "pregnant_or_breastfeeding" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("pregnant_or_breastfeeding" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meals" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NULL, "protein" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("protein" IN (0, 1)), "caffeine" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("caffeine" IN (0, 1)), "heavy" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("heavy" IN (0, 1)), "fried" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("fried" IN (0, 1)), "sugar" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sugar" IN (0, 1)), "veg" TEXT NULL, "alcohol" TEXT NULL, "processed" TEXT NULL, "place" TEXT NULL, "last_meal" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("last_meal" IN (0, 1)), "photo" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "created_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "keep_on_phone" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("keep_on_phone" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ai_reports" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "created_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "offset_min" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "context_schema" TEXT NOT NULL, "context_sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "detail_level" TEXT NOT NULL, "prompt_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "provider_host" TEXT NOT NULL, "model" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NULL, "cards_json" TEXT NULL, "raw_text" TEXT NULL, "dropped_cards" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "prompt_tokens" INTEGER NULL, "completion_tokens" INTEGER NULL, "reasoning_tokens" INTEGER NULL, "cost" REAL NULL, "cost_currency" TEXT NULL, "cost_source" TEXT NOT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "error_kind" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meal_analyses" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "meal_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES meals (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "photo_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "provider_host" TEXT NOT NULL, "model" TEXT NOT NULL, "prompt_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "output_schema" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sent_sha256" TEXT NULL, "sent_width" INTEGER NULL, "sent_height" INTEGER NULL, "sent_bytes" INTEGER NULL, "result_json" TEXT NULL, "raw_text" TEXT NULL, "confidence" TEXT NULL, "prompt_tokens" INTEGER NULL, "completion_tokens" INTEGER NULL, "reasoning_tokens" INTEGER NULL, "cost" REAL NULL, "cost_currency" TEXT NULL, "cost_source" TEXT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "error_kind" TEXT NULL, "hidden_oil" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("hidden_oil" IN (0, 1)), "hidden_sauce" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("hidden_sauce" IN (0, 1)), "hidden_sugar" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("hidden_sugar" IN (0, 1)), "queued_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meal_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "analysis_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES meal_analyses (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "measure" TEXT NOT NULL, "count_x2" INTEGER NOT NULL, "grams" INTEGER NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "confirmed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("confirmed" IN (0, 1)), "food_group" TEXT NULL);
CREATE INDEX ai_reports_cache_key ON ai_reports (kind, context_sha256, prompt_version, provider_host, model, created_at_utc_ms)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX meal_analyses_cache_key ON meal_analyses (meal_id, provider_host, model, prompt_version)
CREATE INDEX meal_analyses_status ON meal_analyses (status)
CREATE INDEX meal_items_analysis ON meal_items (analysis_id)
